unresolved_layers.boundary: The current basic plan and implementation plan began in fiscal 2026. Annual progress governance is established, but a completed current-plan annual progress result is not yet available or resolved and must not be inferred from the expired prior plan.

quality_boundary: This partial inventory confirms the current 2026–2035 basic plan, the 2026–2030 implementation plan, the official annual progress-governance route, fiscal 2026 budget, and fiscal 2024 settlement. It does not substitute prior-plan results for current-plan progress or promote KPI, project, budget, settlement, governance, or outcome records to Reviewed, linked, comparable, causal, or policy-achievement status.
next_action: Capture the first published annual progress result for the current sixth basic plan and Kobe 2030 Vision when available, then review KGI and KPI definitions, implementation projects, fiscal 2026 budget records, and fiscal 2024 settlement records at record-level evidence depth while preserving prior-plan boundaries.
